about: Index of the measured results, one file the reviewer can open instead of five. Every value below is copied programmatically from the source named in `sources`; tests/test_metrics_summary.py fails if this file drifts from any of them. Numbers not stored here (the AUROC bootstrap CI, the per-subgroup tables) live in the notebooks and the docs.
disclaimer: For education only. Not for clinical use.

sources.results/densenet_metrics.json: track A training history, threshold, val/test scores, confusion counts
sources.results/baseline_metrics.json: L0/L1/L2 baselines and the bar the DenseNet had to beat
sources.results/calibration.json: post-hoc calibration on the same 4,003 test predictions
sources.results/gradcam_fairness_summary.json: Grad-CAM focus, subgroup tables, missing-data audit
sources.results/spleen_metrics.json: track B (MONAI DynUNet) test Dice and run configuration
sources.results/plots/confusion_matrix.png: the track A test confusion matrix, plotted from the saved predictions

track_a_classification.dataset: RSNA 2018 Pneumonia Detection Challenge, stage_2 release (label = lung opacity)
track_a_classification.model: torchvision densenet121, IMAGENET1K_V1, head replaced by Linear(1024,1)
track_a_classification.threshold_source: Youden's J maximised on the validation split, then frozen for val and test

calibration.reading: over-confident: mean probability 0.3509 against a 0.2253 base rate is a ranking score, not a risk

gradcam.resolution_note: 7x7 grid upsampled to 448px; overlay is on the uncropped render while the model saw a 224px centre crop

missing_data.item: test images with no 448px render in the cache
missing_data.policy: rendered as an all-black frame so one failed decode cannot lose an epoch; the path is kept in densenet_metrics.json
kept in the predictions, grouped as 'unknown', excluded from the sex table's gap arithmetic
same: an 'unknown' age band, never imputed by the cohort median

missing_data.item: test images whose radiological class could not be joined
missing_data.policy: the label-source slice then reports one 'unavailable' group instead of guessing a class; the binary label itself never came from this file, so no prediction depends on it

missing_data.item: duplicate image paths in the predicted set
missing_data.policy: would be a rows-vs-images leak; notebook 01 splits by patient, not by row

missing_data.item: test images sharing a PatientID with another test image
missing_data.policy: allowed: a patient can contribute several films; splits are held apart by PatientID, which the cell above asserts

limitations: Grad-CAM attributes a decision to image regions; it does not identify a finding and is not localisation ground truth.
Single-institution public challenge data; sex and age come from headers, not from any clinical annotation.
Subgroup gaps are measured differences, not proven model bias - case mix and prevalence differ by group.
PatientPosition is empty across this archive, so AP/PA projection effects cannot be conditioned on or tested.
For education only. Not for clinical use. No regulatory clearance.

track_b_segmentation.model: DynUNet (MONAI 1.5.2), deep supervision x2, sliding-window inference
